notes.title: New Demo for Turbo Kid Is Live!
notes.notes:
As most of you know, we'll be releasing our next game Turbo Kid soon. It's another platformer with just a bit more violence than Brofist. As a token of our appreciation for your continued support, we wanted to ensure that you guys are among the first to experience the magic of Turbo Kid. So, mark your calendars for the [b]10th of April[/b] and get ready to dive into the Wasteland with our new demo!

[h1]IGN Fan Fest Announcement[/h1]

This week IGN announced the launch date for our new game, Turbo Kid! We’re bringing the legendary movie to life and hope you all love it as much as we do

Check out the IGN trailer here
[previewyoutube=d6UizZI0v4A;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]New Demo Live[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10950293/6003b5a804f9683b048c64f0528029224f0fb764.png[/img]

As we are nearing the release date, we've decided to update our demo to give you an experience that's close to the finished game! The demo is available right now, what are you waiting for?!

[h1]What's a Turbo Kid?[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10950293/282c6698dc021a1c7c29c3fdf41446388be24981.png[/img]
Turbo Kid is the Metroidvania you wish you’d played as a kid. Unlock and upgrade ludicrous weapons & skills, obliterate your enemies into bits of pixel gore, and forge your own path as you ride the vast and perilous wasteland on your trusty BMX.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10950293/1ffa0d7477485db944c54aefb619cb84ebbd8862.png[/img]
Our game is set directly after the events of the 2015 movie, Turbo Kid. You’ll get to experience the universe like never before with: 

[b]A whole new story![/b] Set between the end of Turbo Kid and the upcoming Turbo Kid 
sequel developed in collaboration with RKSS and EMA Films, the creators of the 
franchise!

[b]More Gore[/b] than you can shake a ‘gnome stick’ at in this hack ‘n’ slash adventure through the wastelands!

[b]Pedal to the Metal[/b] mowing down enemies to the epic soundtrack from Le Matos, the original creators of the film’s soundtrack.

[b]Turbo Kills, Skills & Thrills[/b] as you power-up, tailwhip, and create brutal weapons and to decapitate your foes. 

Download the demo, wishlist, and venture through the wastelands on your trusty BMX today by visiting our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1733250/Turbo_Kid/]Steam page[/url].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10950293/23215089d6beb02197d19f944b1190a59e8a4509.png[/img]
Thank you for being part of our incredible community, and we'll see you in the wastelands!

notes.title: Only 2 Days Left on Kickstarter for our Next Game
notes.notes:
Hey gang!

It’s happening! The Kickstarter campaign for our next game - a pixel-art retro-inspired metroidvania that takes place in the post-apocalyptic world of the cult hit film Turbo Kid – is coming to a close.

Click here:
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/outerminds/turbo-kid-video-game


[previewyoutube=aHk4WPojlLw;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

Working with the creative team behind the film (Writer-Director triforce RKSS Films, producers EMA Films, electronic band Le Matos) as well as our sound design partners VIBE Avenue, we’re developing a game that’s fun, funny, over-the-top gory, and bicycle heavy, just like the film that inspired it.



[previewyoutube=UJ5Qnayfp7k;rightthumb][/previewyoutube]

Our Kickstarter campaign has been very successful so far and we’ve got some pretty sick stretch goals lined-up. We’d love for you guys to help us hit these goals and be part of the community that helped make this game as awesome as it can be.

Still on the fence?


We also have some exclusive perks available, including a personalized NPC in the game, a corpse with your name on it, and your company’s logo in the game as well as some exclusive swag like these amazing items:

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10950293/16ec180bb4982e26ce0cfacd328261e995ae44f5.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10950293/64afb5ddb0b191fc639463fc092296afd29131ce.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10950293/e1945b9270ed1c1bb1a580db2d24b0479bec773a.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10950293/91b86182a1b5d9c8fef4eb6bc21c86b01c697e6e.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10950293/42cfeaea099b5cf509082f310f6dcb5da34abe24.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/10950293/ea1c446d543f47a6464572152ba1cdf042a70a84.png[/img][/url]


So, what are you waiting for? Head on over to the Turbo Kid Kickstarter page, before it’s too late!
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/outerminds/turbo-kid-video-game
